title: Ding Mengakung Deboto
intro: Metung a kagalang-galang a propeta ing linakad libutad da ring tau, a mamaus karela papunta king katutuan. Dakal la reng tinalikud keng katatagan, pero metung a malating debotong grupu ing mekibat keng tawag ampo mengaku la keng mabilug dang pusu. Mesubukan la king pamagduda at mangahas lang manintun pamangan banua. Ing karelang alang patugut a debosyon meging alang panaun a aral king kasalpantayanan. Ninu ila?
clues: Metung kaming malating grupu na tinalakad para suportan ing metung a banal a misyun keng panaun ning laganap a e kapaniwalan.
Metung a kagalang-galang a propeta ing dinatang at inaus na katamu ban talakad bilang kakampi king dalan nang Allah.
Inyang kitnan na ning propeta nung ninu ing maging talasuporta ning Divino, mekibat kaming alang patugut.
Mengahas kaming maniawad makapagmulalang kapyestan a peparala ibat banwa ban pasiknangan la lub ding kekaming pusu.
Ing kekaming propeta pepaganaka na kekami na galangan mi ya i Allah nung tutu kaming talasalpantaya, pero ing kekaming mapagpakumbaba a anyaran merangalan ya.
Ikami ing debotong inner circle na mengaku keng alang patugut a kasalpantayanan kayabe nang Isa, anak nang Maryam.

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
